resources.string: Shown once for this version. Reopen from “What’s new”.

• Both larger sticks control the same follow point. Map touches do not command in stick mode.\n• Use Settings beside Help to resize, reposition and adjust stick sensitivity, then save or restore defaults.\n• Settings persist across matches, restarts and in-place app updates; existing game rules are unchanged.
Freeze — tap to freeze every enemy for 10 seconds. No target selection needed.
Cleanse — works even while frozen. Immediately unfreezes your army and removes black hole attraction.
Black hole — appears at the map center for 10 seconds and attracts everyone, including you. Nearby units are pulled faster; obstacles still block them. Use Cleanse to escape the pull.
Each active item stacks up to 10. Each use consumes one. Collect them before you need them.
